title: GRIP: A Graph-Based Reasoning Instruction Producer
authors_zh: Jiankang Wang, Jianjun Xu, Xiaorui Wang, Yuxin Wang, Mengting Xing, Shancheng Fang, Hongtao Xie
paper_type_zh: 图引导数学推理数据构造与部分发布
best_for_zh: 研究合成推理数据、概念图重组、多模型筛选及发布审计的读者
one_line: GRIP reports expanding 7.5K MATH seeds into 2,123,345 graph-conditioned question-solution pairs and officially releases 24,957 four-field rows, while code, the full corpus, judge weights, lineage, and licenses remain unavailable.
GRIP 报告把 7.5K 条 MATH 种子扩展为 2,123,345 个图条件问题—解答对，并通过官方补充材料发布 24,957 条四字段样本；代码、完整语料、评审权重、谱系和许可证仍未公开。
why: The work makes graph relationship type, difficulty-routed generation, and separate question/solution gates explicit construction variables; its partial release also exposes the difference between a documented recipe, an inspectable sample, and an audit-ready corpus.
inclusion_reason: GRIP is a concrete graph-based construction recipe that turns a small mathematical seed set into concept-conditioned problem-solution data, exposes model-judge thresholds, and supplies an official audit subset even though the full release and construction machinery remain unavailable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official NeurIPS 2025 paper addresses a construction problem: direct rewriting can keep synthetic reasoning questions close to a small seed set, while large noisy-pool filtering or proprietary teachers can move cost elsewhere. GRIP instead asks whether a seed corpus can be abstracted into mathematical concepts, organized as a relationship graph, and recombined into many new training questions. Its demonstrated scope is mathematics, not a general proof that graph synthesis transfers to every reasoning domain. (Paper Sections 1 and 2.2; Appendix F.)

The source object is all 7,500 question-solution pairs in the MATH training split. The reported target object is GRIP-MATH with exactly 2,123,345 synthesized question-solution pairs, rounded to 2.1M in the main text. The paper uses these pairs for supervised fine-tuning of six 1.5B-8B base models. This Card treats downstream gains as evidence that the selected data can provide training signal under the reported setup, not as proof that every problem or derivation is correct. (Paper Sections 3.5 and 4.1-4.4; Appendix B.)

The release boundary is partial. The official NeurIPS supplemental ZIP contains 24,957 rows with KC1, KC2, question, and solution; its README describes them as a random approximately 25K sample limited by company IP restrictions. It does not include the full corpus, graph, code, rejected candidates, judge records, model checkpoints, or a dataset license. The work belongs in the data-construction/open-release track because its main contribution is a reusable recipe plus a limited official sample, with material release and audit gaps still visible.

NeurIPS 2025 正式论文研究一个数据构造问题：直接改写容易使合成推理题停留在小型种子集附近，而过滤大型噪声池或依赖闭源教师又可能把成本转移到别处。GRIP 转而研究能否把种子语料抽象成数学概念、组织为关系图，再通过重组生成大量新训练题。论文实际验证范围只有数学，并不能证明图式合成必然迁移到所有推理领域。（论文第 1、2.2 节；附录 F。）

源对象是 MATH 训练集全部 7,500 个问题—解答对。论文报告的目标对象 GRIP-MATH 精确包含 2,123,345 个合成问题—解答对，正文将其四舍五入为 2.1M；作者用这些数据监督微调六个 1.5B-8B 基础模型。本卡把下游增益视为所选数据在报告设置中含有训练信号的证据，而不是每道题和每条推导都正确的证明。（论文第 3.5、4.1-4.4 节；附录 B。）

发布边界是不完整的。NeurIPS 官方补充 ZIP 含 24,957 行，字段为 KC1、KC2、question 和 solution；README 称这是受公司 IP 限制而随机抽取的约 25K 子集。它没有提供完整语料、图、代码、拒绝候选、评审记录、模型检查点或数据许可证。本文归入“数据构造与开放发布”轨道，因为核心贡献是一套可复用配方和一个有限官方样本，同时仍保留实质性的发布与审计缺口。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
GRIP's specific contribution is to replace seed-question rewriting with concept-relationship conditioning. Qwen2.5-32B extracts up to 5 key concepts per MATH seed; Qwen2.5-7B and BGE-M3 filter and consolidate them into roughly 10K concepts. Co-occurrence creates weighted explicit edges in a Key Concepts Relationship Graph. One-hop pairs, two-hop paths, hub-centered three-hop paths, and fully connected communities of 3 or 4 concepts then define generation conditions. The original seed question is not placed in the new-problem prompt. (Paper Sections 3.1-3.3; Appendix D.)

The data object is a concept-conditioned problem followed by a natural-language solution. An unnamed model predicts difficulty; Qwen2.5-Math-7B solves low- and medium-difficulty problems, while Qwen2.5-Math-72B handles high-difficulty problems. The released subset serializes only two concept strings plus the question and solution, so graph distance, community membership, difficulty, generator revision, source seed, and judge outputs cannot be recovered per row.

The feedback contract is whole-item model judgment. DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, Qwen2.5-Math-Instruct-7B, and DeepSeek-Math-RL each score problem quality; their scores are weighted by reported mathematical ability, and the average must reach 0.85. Each model separately gives the solution 0 or 1, and one negative vote rejects the pair. The paper does not publish the problem-score weights. This contract selects for judge-approved logical/presentational completeness and solution correctness, but it is not a formal verifier of every derivation step. (Paper Section 3.4.)

The closest prior constructions rewrite seeds or generate from externally supplied topics. GRIP's change is the graph-derived conditioning surface and its use of implicit concept relations, combined with difficulty routing and open-model voting. Concept extraction, LLM generation, rejection filtering, and SFT are not individually new; the novelty lies in how they are composed into a scalable mathematical-data recipe.

GRIP 的具体贡献，是用概念关系条件替代种子题改写。Qwen2.5-32B 从每道 MATH 种子题中提取最多 5 个关键概念，Qwen2.5-7B 与 BGE-M3 再过滤、归并成约 10K 个概念。概念共现形成关键概念关系图中的加权显式边；one-hop 概念对、two-hop 路径、以枢纽为中心的 three-hop 路径，以及由 3 或 4 个概念组成的全连接社群，随后成为生成条件。新题生成提示不包含原始种子题。（论文第 3.1-3.3 节；附录 D。）

数据对象是概念条件问题及其自然语言解答。一个未命名模型先预测难度；Qwen2.5-Math-7B 解决低、中难度题，Qwen2.5-Math-72B 处理高难度题。官方子集只序列化两个概念字符串、问题和解答，因此无法逐行恢复图距离、社群归属、难度、生成器版本、源种子或评审输出。

反馈合同是整项模型判断。DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B、Qwen2.5-Math-Instruct-7B 与 DeepSeek-Math-RL 分别给题目质量打分；分数按模型报告的数学能力加权，平均值须达到 0.85。每个模型还分别给解答 0 或 1，任意一个否决就淘汰该对。论文没有公布题目分数权重。该合同会选择被评审模型认可为逻辑/表述完整且解答正确的样本，但不是对每个推导步骤的形式化验证。（论文第 3.4 节。）

最接近的既有方法会改写种子，或依据外部主题生成。GRIP 的变化是图导出的条件界面及其对隐式概念关系的利用，并把它与难度路由和开放模型投票组合起来。概念抽取、LLM 生成、拒绝筛选和 SFT 单独看都不是新组件；新意在于把它们组合成可扩展的数学数据配方。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reconstructable pipeline is:

  1. Seed and concept extraction. Start from 7,500 MATH training question-solution pairs. Qwen2.5-32B extracts 1-5 atomic concepts under the published Prompt A.1.
  2. Dual concept filtering. Qwen2.5-7B removes vague, incorrect, or over-detailed concepts. BGE-M3 similarity 0.90-1.00 triggers direct grouping; 0.70-0.90 triggers an LLM synonym decision; below 0.70 remains distinct. An LLM chooses or synthesizes a representative label, leaving roughly 10K concepts. Appendix D reports that the share of generated problems passing the authors' quality check rises from 26% with embedding-only deduplication to 45% with dual filtering.
  3. Graph and combination selection. Co-occurring concepts receive weighted explicit edges. GRIP enumerates one-hop pairs, two-hop pairs sharing a neighbor, three-hop pairs between a hub and a concept three edges away, and fully connected communities of 3 or 4 concepts. Low-weight three-hop relations are removed, but the cutoff is undisclosed.
  4. Problem and solution generation. Qwen2.5-32B receives concepts and Prompt A.2 without the source question. An unnamed rating model assigns difficulty. Qwen2.5-Math-7B produces low/medium solutions and Qwen2.5-Math-72B produces high-difficulty solutions. Temperature, top-p, token limits, retries, seeds, and raw candidate counts are unknown.
  5. Multi-model selection. Three open mathematical models score problem logical/presentational completeness from 0 to 1. An undisclosed weighted average must be at least 0.85. The same models give binary solution judgments; unanimous acceptance is required. No symbolic execution, theorem prover, or process-step verifier is used.
  6. Output and release. The paper reports 2,123,345 retained pairs from 8 A100 80GB GPUs over 36 hours with vLLM. The official supplemental JSON releases 24,957 randomly selected rows with only KC1, KC2, question, and solution.
  7. Downstream SFT. Six base models are trained exclusively on GRIP-MATH using LLaMAFactory for 2 epochs, learning rate 5e-6, global batch 128, sequence length 4,096, cosine scheduling, 3% warm-up, DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 3, and FlashAttention 2. The optimizer, model revisions, random seeds, and per-run compute are not stated. (Paper Sections 3-4; Appendices A, B, and D.)

Faithful reproduction additionally requires the concept graph, branch counts, low-weight cutoff, difficulty model, exact judge weights/prompts, all generated and rejected records, split manifest, model revisions, and license. The supplemental sample supplies none of those fields, so it supports row-level inspection but not end-to-end reconstruction.

可重建的流程如下：

  1. 种子与概念抽取。 从 7,500 个 MATH 训练问题—解答对开始；Qwen2.5-32B 按公开的 Prompt A.1 抽取 1-5 个原子概念。
  2. 双重概念过滤。 Qwen2.5-7B 删除含糊、错误或过度具体的概念。BGE-M3 相似度为 0.90-1.00 时直接分组，0.70-0.90 时交由 LLM 判断是否同义，低于 0.70 则保持不同。LLM 为每组选择或合成代表标签，最终留下约 10K 个概念。附录 D 报告，仅用嵌入去重时通过作者质量检查的生成题占 26%，加入双重过滤后升至 45%。
  3. 图与组合选择。 共现概念之间建立加权显式边。GRIP 枚举 one-hop 概念对、共享邻居的 two-hop 概念对、枢纽与距离 3 条边的概念构成的 three-hop 对，以及由 3 或 4 个概念组成的全连接社群。低权 three-hop 关系会被删除，但截止值未披露。
  4. 问题与解答生成。 Qwen2.5-32B 接收概念和 Prompt A.2，但不接收源题。未命名评分模型分配难度；Qwen2.5-Math-7B 生成低/中难度解答，Qwen2.5-Math-72B 生成高难度解答。temperature、top-p、token 上限、重试、随机种子和原始候选数均未知。
  5. 多模型选择。 三个开放数学模型以 0 到 1 评价题目的逻辑与表述完整性；一个未披露权重的加权平均值必须至少为 0.85。同一组模型再对解答作二元判断，只有全票接受才保留。流程没有使用符号执行、定理证明器或过程步骤验证器。
  6. 输出与发布。 论文报告用 8 张 A100 80GB GPU 和 vLLM 运行 36 小时后保留 2,123,345 对。官方补充 JSON 随机发布 24,957 行，只有 KC1、KC2、question 和 solution。
  7. 下游 SFT。 六个基础模型只在 GRIP-MATH 上训练，使用 LLaMAFactory、2 个 epoch、学习率 5e-6、全局 batch 128、序列长度 4,096、余弦日程、3% warm-up、DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 3 和 FlashAttention 2。优化器、模型版本、随机种子和逐次运行计算量未说明。（论文第 3-4 节；附录 A、B、D。）

忠实复现还需要概念图、各分支计数、低权截止值、难度模型、精确的评审权重/提示、全部生成与拒绝记录、切分清单、模型版本和许可证。补充子集不含这些字段，因此只能支持逐行检查，不能支持端到端重建。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The construction statistics establish scale under the authors' accounting. Table 1 reports a 280-fold expansion from 7.5K seeds to 2.1M pairs and 71.8% of generated questions using concept combinations absent from the seed set. Appendix B gives the exact denominator 2,123,345 and estimates 0.000057 USD per retained pair from 8 A100 80GB GPUs for 36 hours at a quoted rental price. These figures omit labor, unsuccessful experiments, training runs, and the cost of developing the pipeline. Embedding similarity and concept-combination novelty measure distance from seeds, not mathematical correctness. (Paper Section 3.5; Appendix B.)

The component evidence is mixed and informative. Table 4's average question-quality score falls from 0.94 for one-hop to 0.72 for two-hop and 0.62 for hub-constrained three-hop; removing the hub constraint yields 0.39 at three hops and 0.21 at four hops. Table 6 reports 0.83 with concept filtering versus 0.61 without it. Table 7 trains Mistral-7B on matched 0.2M groups: one-/two-/three-hop data scores 32.6 on MATH and 71.2 on GSM8K, compared with 29.3 and 67.6 for one-hop plus duplicated one-hop synthesis. These are author-reported ablations, not an independent data audit. (Paper Section 4.5.)

For the judge, 500 synthesized problems receive human qualified/unqualified labels. Table 5 reports 95.7% accuracy for the three-model combination and 94.3% for GPT-4.1. The paper does not disclose the human sampling frame, annotator count, instructions, agreement, or confidence intervals. Reverse concept extraction reports 88.65% full and 98.49% partial adherence, but reuses Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct and omits the sample size. (Paper Section 4.5; Appendix E.3.)

Downstream SFT supports usefulness under the tested setup. Table 2 raises Mistral-7B's five-benchmark mathematical average from 28.0 to 57.3 and Qwen2-7B from 66.5 to 70.2. Appendix Table 11 reports GRIP-MATH-mini at 43.0 versus 38.8 for an equally sized 80K MathCoder comparison on Mistral-7B. These results combine generation, filtering, scale, and training; they do not prove row-level quality or isolate one causal component.

The official subset enables a limited independent structural check. All 24,957 rows have the four documented non-empty fields. There are 24,954 unique question strings, leaving 3 exact duplicate-question groups attached to different concept labels; there are 24,946 unique solution strings. This is evidence that the sample is inspectable and not perfectly question-unique, but it cannot estimate the full corpus's correctness or duplication rate because the README supplies neither the sampling seed nor a full-population manifest.

构建统计在作者的核算口径下证明了规模。表 1 报告从 7.5K 种子扩张到 2.1M 对，即 280 倍；71.8% 的生成题使用了种子集中未出现的概念组合。附录 B 给出精确分母 2,123,345，并按报价估算 8 张 A100 80GB GPU 运行 36 小时后每条保留样本成本为 0.000057 USD。这些数字不含人工、失败实验、训练运行和流水线开发成本。嵌入相似度与概念组合新颖度衡量的是距种子的距离，而不是数学正确性。（论文第 3.5 节；附录 B。）

组件证据既有正面结果，也暴露边界。表 4 的平均题目质量分从 one-hop 的 0.94 降到 two-hop 的 0.72 和受枢纽约束 three-hop 的 0.62；移除枢纽约束后，three-hop 为 0.39，four-hop 为 0.21。表 6 报告有概念过滤时为 0.83，无过滤时为 0.61。表 7 用匹配的 0.2M 数据组训练 Mistral-7B：one-/two-/three-hop 数据在 MATH、GSM8K 上为 32.6、71.2，而 one-hop 加重复 one-hop 合成为 29.3、67.6。这些是作者报告的消融，不是独立数据审计。（论文第 4.5 节。）

在评审器实验中，500 道合成题获得人工“合格/不合格”标签。表 5 报告三模型组合准确率 95.7%，GPT-4.1 为 94.3%。论文没有披露人工样本框、标注者数量、说明、协议一致性或置信区间。反向概念抽取报告 88.65% 完全匹配和 98.49% 部分匹配，但复用了 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，且没有给出样本量。（论文第 4.5 节；附录 E.3。）

下游 SFT 证明数据在测试设置中有用。表 2 把 Mistral-7B 的五项数学基准平均分从 28.0 提升到 57.3，把 Qwen2-7B 从 66.5 提升到 70.2。附录表 11 在 Mistral-7B 上报告 GRIP-MATH-mini 为 43.0，而同为 80K 规模的 MathCoder 对照为 38.8。这些结果同时混合生成、筛选、规模和训练，不能证明逐条质量，也不能隔离某一组件的因果作用。

官方子集支持有限的独立结构检查。24,957 行全部具有文档所述的 4 个非空字段；其中有 24,954 个唯一问题字符串，即存在 3 组附着于不同概念标签的完全重复问题；唯一解答字符串为 24,946 个。这证明样本可检查且并非问题完全唯一，但 README 没有给出采样种子或全量清单，因此不能据此估计完整语料的正确率或重复率。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The baseline construction interface is a seed question or an externally supplied topic. Rewriting preserves the seed's wording and concept bundle; topic-conditioned synthesis can still depend on proprietary models or a manually curated topic source. GRIP instead makes a derived graph the generation substrate: explicit edges preserve observed co-occurrence, while two-hop and hub-centered three-hop paths deliberately expose concept pairs that did not co-occur in one seed problem. Community cliques add 3- or 4-concept conditions. (Paper Figure 1 and Sections 2.2-3.3.)

The direction signal is operational rather than rhetorical. Relationship type, graph distance, hub status, predicted difficulty, solution-teacher size, problem threshold, and unanimous solution voting become separately testable construction variables. The hop ablation shows why this matters: moving farther in the graph increases combinatorial supply while lowering average judge score, creating an explicit diversity-quality-cost tradeoff.

GRIP also replaces a single closed-source judge with three open mathematical models. That improves inspectability of model identities and the acceptance rule, but it does not create a new correctness oracle. The weights remain unknown, the models can share errors, and binary solution votes judge whole text rather than steps. The official 24,957-row sample is a useful release improvement over paper-only recipes, yet its four-field schema omits the variables required to test the claimed graph mechanism row by row.

Concept graphs, LLM synthesis, difficulty routing, ensemble judgment, and supervised fine-tuning are not individually novel. The concrete contribution is their composition around implicit graph relationships and a large expansion study. Before reuse, the key quality signal should be reproduced with released branch labels, rejection logs, independent verification, and controlled comparisons that hold generator and sample budget fixed.

既有构造接口通常是种子题或外部给定主题。改写会保留种子措辞与概念组合，主题条件生成仍可能依赖闭源模型或人工整理的主题来源。GRIP 改为让派生图充当生成底座：显式边保留已观察共现，two-hop 与以枢纽为中心的 three-hop 路径则有意暴露未在同一道种子题中共现的概念对；社群 clique 进一步提供 3 或 4 个概念的条件。（论文图 1 与第 2.2-3.3 节。）

它提供的是可操作的方向信号，而不是口号。关系类型、图距离、枢纽身份、预测难度、解答教师规模、题目阈值和解答全票规则成为可以分别测试的构造变量。hop 消融说明其意义：图中距离越远，组合供给越多，但平均评审分越低，从而显式形成多样性—质量—成本权衡。

GRIP 还用三个开放数学模型替代单一闭源评审器。这提高了模型身份和接受规则的可检查性，却没有产生新的正确性 oracle。权重仍未知，模型可能共享错误，二元解答投票判断整段文本而不是步骤。官方 24,957 行子集比只有论文的配方更进一步，但四字段 schema 省略了逐行检验图机制所需的变量。

概念图、LLM 合成、难度路由、集成判断和监督微调分别看都不是新方法。具体贡献是围绕隐式图关系组合这些组件，并进行大规模扩张研究。复用前，应在发布分支标签、拒绝日志和独立验证的条件下重现关键质量信号，并用固定生成器与样本预算的受控比较核验机制。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Partial, underspecified release: The official supplemental ZIP provides 24,957 rows rather than 2,123,345, and only KC1, KC2, question, and solution. It omits graph relation, difficulty, seed lineage, judge scores, model versions, split, and rejection state. The README promises later release but provides no sampling seed, license, or versioned full-data path.
  • No verified implementation: No official code repository, project page, full dataset, model checkpoint, or Hugging Face release was verified as of 2026-07-21. Exact graph code, low-weight cutoff, difficulty model, judge weights/prompts, decoding parameters, retries, optimizer, and random seeds are unknown.
  • Model judgment is not proof: Three related mathematical LLMs can share misconceptions, benchmark exposure, or stylistic preferences. Unanimous acceptance does not formally establish that a solution's intermediate derivation is valid. The 0.85 problem score cannot be reproduced without the unpublished weights.
  • Judge study underreported: The 500-item human comparison omits sampling frame, annotator count, instructions, agreement, and uncertainty. The paper explicitly reports no error bars or statistical-significance analysis. A 95.7% aggregate agreement does not reveal false-acceptance rates in the 2.1M pool.
  • Graph compatibility is heuristic: The paper's own ablation drops from 0.94 at one hop to 0.62 at hub-constrained three hops and 0.21 at unconstrained four hops. Indirect proximity can generate contrived, ambiguous, or unsolvable problems; unpublished branch rejection counts hide the resulting yield.
  • Concept and sample duplication: Extraction and similarity clustering can merge distinct concepts or preserve synonyms. The official sample contains 3 exact duplicate-question groups among 24,957 rows, and the graph/intermediate vocabulary is not available for deeper normalization audits.
  • Limited and non-independent validation: Reverse concept adherence reuses Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct and omits sample size. Decontamination covers only lexical n-gram overlap with MATH test, not semantic leakage, solution overlap, other evaluation sets, or contamination inherited through generator/judge pretraining.
  • Narrow domain and attribution: The construction is tested only on English mathematical reasoning derived from MATH. Downstream gains combine scale, generator capability, filtering, teacher routing, and SFT; they neither isolate the graph's causal contribution nor prove transfer to other domains.
  • Cost boundary: The 0.000057 USD estimate counts 36 hours of 8 A100 80GB GPUs at one quoted rental rate for synthesis/scoring. It excludes labor, pipeline development, failed runs, full model training, storage, and future reproduction costs.
  • License and governance unknown: The supplemental package contains no data license. MATH-derived concept rights, generated-question/solution terms, code terms, model-output redistribution, intended uses, and removal/correction procedures remain undisclosed.

• 发布不完整且规格不足： 官方补充 ZIP 只提供 24,957 行，而非 2,123,345 行；字段仅有 KC1、KC2、question 和 solution。图关系、难度、种子谱系、评审分、模型版本、切分和拒绝状态均缺失。README 承诺后续发布，却没有采样种子、许可证或带版本的全量数据路径。
  • 没有经验证的实现： 截至 2026-07-21，没有核实到官方代码仓库、项目页、完整数据集、模型检查点或 Hugging Face 发布。图实现、低权截止值、难度模型、评审权重/提示、解码参数、重试、优化器和随机种子均未知。
  • 模型判断不是证明： 三个相关数学 LLM 可能共享误解、基准暴露或风格偏好。全票接受不能形式化证明解答的中间推导有效；没有未公开的权重，也无法重建 0.85 题目分数。
  • 评审器研究披露不足： 500 条人工对照没有报告样本框、标注者数量、说明、协议一致性和不确定性。论文明确没有误差条或统计显著性分析；95.7% 总体一致率不能给出 2.1M 池中的误接受率。
  • 图兼容性只是启发式： 论文消融从 one-hop 的 0.94 降到受枢纽约束 three-hop 的 0.62，以及无约束 four-hop 的 0.21。间接邻近可能生成牵强、含糊或无解问题，而未公开的分支拒绝数隐藏了实际产率。
  • 概念与样本重复： 抽取和相似度聚类可能合并不同概念或保留同义项。官方 24,957 行样本中有 3 组完全重复问题，图和中间词表未发布，无法进一步做归一化审计。
  • 验证有限且不独立： 反向概念遵循测试复用 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，且没有披露样本量。去污染只覆盖与 MATH test 的词法 n-gram 重叠，没有检查语义泄漏、解答重叠、其他评测集或生成器/评审器预训练继承的污染。
  • 领域狭窄且归因不清： 构造只在由 MATH 派生的英文数学推理上测试。下游增益同时混合规模、生成器能力、筛选、教师路由和 SFT，既不能隔离图机制的因果贡献，也不能证明迁移到其他领域。
  • 成本边界： 0.000057 USD 估算只按一个报价计算 8 张 A100 80GB GPU 运行 36 小时的合成/评分成本，不含人工、流水线开发、失败运行、完整模型训练、存储和未来复现成本。
  • 许可与治理未知： 补充包没有数据许可证。MATH 派生概念权利、生成问题/解答条款、代码条款、模型输出再分发、预期用途及删除/纠错流程均未披露。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data-construction/open-release track, GRIP is most useful as a graph-conditioned synthesis recipe plus a partial audit sample. A builder can adapt the sequence—extract atomic concepts, normalize a vocabulary, construct explicit and implicit relationships, choose combinations by graph type, route solution teachers by difficulty, and apply separate problem and solution gates—without assuming that the reported 2.1M corpus is available or verified.

The official 24,957-row sample supports schema inspection, duplicate checks, spot review, and experiments on question/solution text. It does not support faithful branch-level analysis because it lacks relationship type, graph path, difficulty, source seed, judge outputs, and rejection records. Training reuse should remain conditional on an explicit license and an audit of correctness, contamination, provenance, and duplication; the README's future-release promise is not a current reuse grant.

The design suggests controlled research questions for this track: compare rewriting with graph recombination at fixed generation budget; measure validity and novelty by hop distance; disclose yield before and after every gate; test independent symbolic or human verification against correlated model voting; and retain failed candidates as negative/audit data. A strong replication should also separate the effect of more samples from the effect of implicit graph relationships.

Reuse class: recipe and audit-subset reference; not an audit-ready full training release. The Card supplies enough evidence to reproduce the study design at a high level and to inspect the official sample, but not to recreate the authors' graph, selection decisions, or full corpus.

在“数据构造与开放发布”轨道中，GRIP 最适合作为图条件合成配方和部分审计样本。构建者可以借鉴“抽取原子概念—归一化词表—构建显式/隐式关系—按图类型选择组合—按难度路由解答教师—分别设置题目与解答门槛”的序列，但不能假定论文报告的 2.1M 语料已经可获得或经验证。

官方 24,957 行样本可用于检查 schema、查重、抽样审阅，以及对问题/解答文本做实验。它缺少关系类型、图路径、难度、源种子、评审输出和拒绝记录，因而不能支持忠实的分支级分析。训练复用应以明确许可证和正确性、污染、来源、重复审计为前提；README 的未来发布承诺并不是当前复用授权。

该设计为本轨道提出了受控研究问题：在固定生成预算下比较改写与图重组；按 hop 距离测量有效性和新颖性；披露每个门槛前后的产率；以独立符号或人工验证对比相关模型投票；把失败候选保留为负例/审计数据。严格复现还应把样本量增加的影响与隐式图关系的影响分开。

复用等级：配方与审计子集参考，不是审计就绪的完整训练发布。本卡证据足以高层复现研究设计并检查官方样本，却不足以重建作者的图、选择决策或完整语料。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the official supplemental ZIP as a partial release: its README says approximately 25K, while the JSON contains exactly 24,957 four-field rows rather than the reported 2,123,345-pair corpus.
  • In Sections 3.1-3.3, separate the reusable graph recipe from unreleased state: concept nodes and relationship types are described, but the actual graph, cutoffs, branch counts, difficulty labels, and lineage are absent.
  • In Section 3.4, treat 0.85 plus unanimous voting as a model-judge selection contract, not formal or step-level mathematical verification; the weighted-score coefficients are undisclosed.
  • Read Tables 4-7 as both mechanism and failure evidence: implicit relationships expand supply, while average judge scores fall as hop distance grows.
  • Use Appendix E.2 narrowly: it reports MATH-test n-gram overlap only, not decontamination for every benchmark or semantic/solution-level leakage.
  • Do not infer data quality from benchmark gains; the partial release, 3 exact duplicate-question groups, missing license, and absent full pipeline still require independent audit.

• 把官方补充 ZIP 视为部分发布：README 称约 25K，而 JSON 精确包含 24,957 条四字段记录，并非论文报告的 2,123,345 对完整语料。
  • 阅读第 3.1-3.3 节时区分可复用图配方与未发布状态：论文描述了概念节点和关系类型，却没有发布实际图、截止值、分支计数、难度标签与谱系。
  • 在第 3.4 节，把 0.85 加全票机制视为模型评审选择合同，而不是形式化或步骤级数学验证；加权分系数没有披露。
  • 把表 4-7 同时视为机制与失败证据：隐式关系扩大供给，但平均评审分随 hop 距离增加而下降。
  • 狭义使用附录 E.2：它只报告与 MATH test 的 n-gram 重叠，并不覆盖每个基准或语义/解答级泄漏。
  • 不要用基准增益反推数据质量；部分发布、3 组完全重复问题、许可证缺失和完整流水线缺席仍需独立审计。

items: Every concept is derived from MATH train, so graph recombination can enlarge combinations while retaining the seed corpus's domain, language, and style biases.

Graph distance and community membership are heuristics for compatibility; the paper's hop ablation shows quality scores fall from 0.94 at one hop to 0.62 at three hops and 0.21 at four hops without hub constraints.
Concept extraction, synonym clustering, and representative-label synthesis can merge distinct ideas or preserve duplicates; exact intermediate graph artifacts are unavailable.

The three judges are related mathematical language models rather than independent formal verifiers. Shared errors or preferences can survive unanimous voting, and the problem-score weights are not published.

The official subset omits relation type, difficulty, scores, model versions, source seed, rejection reason, and split. A structural audit found 24,954 unique question strings among 24,957 rows, including three duplicate-question groups with different concept labels.
Reverse concept-adherence evaluation reuses Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, the extraction model family used by the pipeline, and does not disclose its sample size; it is not independent validation.

The 500-item judge comparison reports accuracy against human labels but does not disclose annotator count, instructions, agreement, sampling frame, or confidence intervals. The paper reports no statistical-significance analysis.
Only MATH-test n-gram overlap is reported. Other evaluation sets, semantic leakage, model pretraining contamination, and solution-level overlap remain unaudited.

The official supplemental README attributes the partial release to company IP restrictions and promises later release, but no verified official code, full corpus, model checkpoint, immutable construction manifest, or dataset license was found as of 2026-07-21.
每个概念均派生自 MATH train，因此图重组可扩大组合，同时保留种子语料的领域、语言与风格偏差。
图距离与社区成员资格是兼容性启发式；论文的跳数消融显示，在无枢纽约束时质量分数从一跳的 0.94 降至三跳的 0.62 与四跳的 0.21。
概念提取、同义词聚类与代表标签合成可合并不同想法或保留重复；确切中间图产物不可得。
三个评审模型是相关的数学语言模型，而非独立的形式验证器。共享错误或偏好可在一致投票中幸存，且问题分数权重未发表。
官方子集省略关系类型、难度、分数、模型版本、来源种子、拒绝原因与划分。结构审计在 24,957 行中发现 24,954 个唯一问题字符串，包括三组概念标签不同的重复问题。
反向概念遵循评测复用流水线所用提取模型族 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，且未披露其样本量；它不是独立验证。
500 条评审比较报告相对人工标签的准确率，但未披露标注者数量、指令、一致性、抽样框或置信区间。论文未报告统计显著性分析。
仅报告 MATH-test n-gram 重叠。其余评测集、语义泄漏、模型预训练污染与解答级重叠仍未经审计。
官方补充 README 将部分发布归因于公司 IP 限制并承诺稍后发布，但截至 2026-07-21 未找到经核验的官方代码、完整语料、模型检查点、不可变构建清单或数据集许可。
